crew_workspace_step_almost_there: Idle word of the working line, between tool calls.
crew_workspace_step_building: Working line of a crewmate: its shell command builds or type-checks the project.
crew_workspace_step_editing: Working line of a crewmate that edits without a file name.
crew_workspace_step_editing_file: Working line of a crewmate that edits a file; {file} is the file's name.
crew_workspace_step_figuring_it_out: Idle word of the working line, between tool calls.
crew_workspace_step_git: Working line of a crewmate: its shell command is git.
crew_workspace_step_github: Working line of a crewmate: its shell command is the gh CLI.
crew_workspace_step_installing_dependenc: Working line of a crewmate: its shell command installs packages.
crew_workspace_step_looking_around: Idle word of the working line, between tool calls.
crew_workspace_step_looking_for_files: Working line of a crewmate that lists files by a glob.
crew_workspace_step_planning: Idle word of the working line, between tool calls.
crew_workspace_step_reading: Working line of a crewmate that reads without a file name.
crew_workspace_step_reading_file: Working line of a crewmate that reads a file; {file} is the file's name.
crew_workspace_step_running_command: Working line of a crewmate that runs a shell command with no name to show.
crew_workspace_step_running_program: Working line of a crewmate that runs a program; {program} is its name.
crew_workspace_step_running_tests: Working line of a crewmate: its shell command runs a test suite.
crew_workspace_step_searching: Working line of a crewmate that searches without a pattern.
crew_workspace_step_searching_for: Working line of a crewmate that greps; {query} is the pattern it looks for.
crew_workspace_step_using_tool: Working line of a crewmate that calls a tool this app does not know; {tool} is the tool's name in words.
crew_workspace_step_writing: Working line of a crewmate that writes without a file name.
crew_workspace_step_writing_file: Working line of a crewmate that writes a file; {file} is the file's name.
